Bundle Residual Distribution Functions

residual_law.Rd

Store a named parameter vector and residual distribution functions without evaluating the functions or drawing random numbers.

Usage

residual_law(param = numeric(), density = NULL, cdf = NULL,
             quantile = NULL, rng = NULL, name = "custom")

Arguments

param

Finite numeric vector with unique, nonempty parameter names.

density, cdf, quantile, rng

Distribution functions, or NULL. Use R distribution signatures: the variate, probability or sample count is the first argument. Named parameters are matched to explicit formal arguments as in emhawkes::set_residual. Log-density and tail options are supported there.

name

A descriptive label, not a verified distribution-family identifier.

Details

At least a density or random generator is required. Simulation needs a generator; likelihood evaluation needs a density, and multivariate likelihoods also need a CDF. Residual inference needs a CDF and quantile function. The constructor does not establish consistency of user-supplied functions, normalization of residual scale, existence of moments, or parameter identification.

Value

An object of class frpp_residual_law.
